observations: Photo 0: Front view of a Canon EOS 600D camera body with a body cap and a Canon EFS 18-55mm lens with a lens cap.
Photo 1: Rear view of the camera; the articulating LCD screen is flipped closed, showing only the plastic back.
Photo 2: Two cameras on a shelf; the EOS 600D with the 18-55mm lens and an EOS 700D with a 28-90mm lens.
All photos feature a 'KJ-TECH' watermark, suggesting a commercial seller.
The exterior of the camera body and lens barrel appear clean and free of significant wear.

claims.evidence: The exterior surfaces in photos 0 and 1 show no significant scuffs or dirt.
No sample images taken with the camera are provided.
Requires a screenshot from a shutter count verification tool.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: The lens caps are on in all photos, hiding the glass elements.
These accessories are not shown in the photos.

risks.proof: A photo or video of the articulating screen flipped open and powered on.
risks.if_unproven: as a broken or non-functional screen

risks.risk: Lens optics issues (fungus, scratches, or haze)
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front and rear lens glass without caps.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged lens requiring replacement

risks.proof: A photo of the sensor with the mirror locked up, or a sample image of a white wall at f/22.
risks.if_unproven: as a sensor requiring professional cleaning or repair

risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from software like EOSCard.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage unit near the end of its service life

proof_requests: Photo of the LCD screen flipped open and powered on showing the menu.
Photos of the front and rear glass elements of the 18-55mm lens without the caps.
A screenshot confirming the shutter count.
Photos of the included battery and charger.
response.reason: The seller has flipped the articulating screen closed and left the lens caps on, concealing the most critical and fragile components of the camera. A valuation is not possible without confirming the condition of the LCD and the optics.
